steps.label: scene boots into play

steps.js: (() => { const n = window.__GF.state().nodes; return n.tree.alive >= 8 && n.rock.alive >= 3 && n.bush.alive >= 3; })()
steps.label: resource nodes scattered on the heightfield (trees, rocks, bushes)
weather starts clear
clear-day frame renders
bare-hand harvest fells a tree and yields wood
harvesting a rock yields stone
bushes yield fiber and berries
felled tree is removed (stump left)
canCraft explains the axe is missing rope
rope crafted after its craft time
axe is still in the crafting queue mid-way
stone axe crafted
axe equipped
the axe fells trees in fewer hits than bare hands

steps.js: (() => { const n = window.__GF.nodes.nearest(window.__GF.app.camera.position, { type: 'tree' }); window.__GF.cheat.goTo(n.position.x, n.position.z - 1.6, 0); return window.__GF.cheat.rayHarvest()?.type === 'tree'; })()
steps.label: raycast from the eye hits and harvests a tree trunk
campfire kit crafted
foundation ghost preview is visible and valid on flat ground
ghost preview frame renders

steps.js: (() => { const n = window.__GF.nodes.nearest({ x: 0, z: 0 }, { type: 'tree' }); const r = window.__GF.cheat.previewAt('campfire', n.position.x + 0.2, n.position.z); return !r.valid && /tree/.test(r.reason); })()
steps.label: placement over a tree is invalid (red ghost, reason given)
roof without walls is rejected (structural rule)

steps.js: (() => { const b = window.__GF.state().build; return b.foundation === 1 && b.wall >= 2 && b.roof === 1 && b.campfire === 1; })()
steps.label: shelter built: foundation, walls, doorway, roof and campfire
placing the campfire used the crafted kit

steps.js: (() => { const c = window.__sh.center; window.__GF.cheat.goTo(c.x - 1.5, c.z - 6, 0.25); window.__GF.cheat.view(0.0, 0.25, 4.2); window.__n0 = window.__GF.state().needs; })()
(() => { const a = window.__n0, b = window.__GF.state().needs; return b.hunger < a.hunger && b.thirst < a.thirst && b.fatigue > a.fatigue; })()
steps.label: needs tick over time (hunger, thirst, fatigue)
lit campfire acts as a crafting station nearby

steps.js: (() => { const w = window.__GF.state().weather; return w.rain > 0.1 && w.rain < 0.6 && w.blend < 1; })()
steps.label: clear -> rain transitions smoothly (mid-blend)

steps.js: (() => { const w = window.__GF.state().weather; return w.rain >= 0.64 && w.rainDrops > 2000 && w.wetness > 0.5 && w.fog > 2; })()
steps.label: rain: GPU drops visible, fog thickens, surfaces get wet
player outside in the rain gets wet
rain frame renders

steps.js: (() => { const w = window.__GF.state().weather; return w.state === 'storm' && w.wind > 6 && w.rain > 0.95; })()
steps.label: rain -> storm: wind rises, heavy rain
storm produces lightning strikes (seeded)
thunder follows the flash (distance delay)

steps.js: (() => { const c = window.__sh.center; window.__GF.cheat.goTo(c.x, c.z + 0.3, Math.PI); window.__GF.cheat.view(0, 0.2, 1.2); })()

steps.label: inside the built shelter counts as sheltered

steps.js: window.__saved = window.__GF.cheat.saveGame(); window.__before = JSON.stringify([window.__GF.state().inv, window.__GF.state().build, window.__GF.state().weather.state, window.__GF.state().tool.kind])

steps.label: state scrambled before loading
save/load round trip restores inventory, buildings, weather and equipment
all 7 survival/weather systems registered with the save system

steps.js: (() => { window.__GF.render(); const m = window.__GF.metrics(); return m.calls < 700 && m.triangles < 3000000; })()
steps.label: frame within budget (< 700 draw calls, < 3 M triangles)

steps.js: (() => { const c = window.__sh.center; window.__GF.cheat.goTo(c.x - 1.5, c.z - 6, 0.25); window.__GF.cheat.view(0.0, 0.25, 4.2); window.__GF.cheat.setWeather('snow', 4); })()
(() => { const w = window.__GF.state().weather; return w.snowFlakes > 1500 && w.rainDrops === 0 && w.temperature < 0 && w.snowCover > 0.35; })()
steps.label: storm -> snow: flakes replace rain, snow cover builds below freezing
